rules.R1_priority: within the same consumer_variant, a program with a delayed-positive adopted or full-batch record in at least 2 distinct cohorts, ordered by cross-cohort mean delayed
rules.R2_risk: a program with a delayed-negative full-batch record in at least 2 distinct cohorts
rules.R3_mask_locality: if the windows artifact's mask-stable share is at most 0.3333, masks must be re-searched locally and never reused

compiler.delayed_only: R1 and R2 read only rows that record a delayed number; a Support reading is never substituted for a missing delayed one
compiler.empty_is_empty: a rule with no usable row produces nothing; a target whose three rules all produce nothing is ABSTAIN_TO_DEFAULT and A5 should then behave exactly like A3
compiler.loco: every row measured on the target's own cohort is dropped

instrument_corrections: the adoption gate gains the identity incumbent
the bar is identity at zero plus the evaluated full-batch plans whose Support is strictly positive; see V2_GATE_SEMANTICS for how that differs from the literal v2 rule
pre_registered.cost_accounting: every Consumer retrain is counted: identity baselines, shortlist evaluations, the mask round's internal per-series retrains, and the delayed gate. One evaluation over three origins is three retrains

arms.A5: exactly one addition: the rendered Skill card. The raw experience table is never shown

pre_registered.delivery_check: A5's stage-one payload must cite at least one clause id that exists on its card; otherwise the target is SKILL_NOT_DELIVERED regardless of who won
pre_registered.per_target_label: paired delayed delta = A5 delayed minus A3 delayed; > +0.005 is A5_WINS, < -0.005 is A5_LOSES, otherwise TIE
overall_verdict_in_this_order: SKILL_COMPILATION_INSUFFICIENT_PROVENANCE: all three targets compiled to ABSTAIN_TO_DEFAULT
SKILL_LOSES_SIGNAL: at least one target is A5_LOSES; the failing clause is named
SKILL_BRIDGE_DELIVERS: delivery confirmed on every non-abstaining target, no A5_LOSES, and at least one A5_WINS
SKILL_BRIDGE_NO_EFFECT: added before the run because the three labels above are not exhaustive -- delivery holds, nothing loses, nothing wins
pre_registered.cost_report_has_no_criterion: total retrains per arm-target, and the cumulative retrains each arm spent before its first delayed-positive adoption, are reported as a first measurement and decide nothing
pre_registered.circuit_breaker: stop if the first arm-target produces no payload
pre_registered.no_cross_target_feedback: the three targets are independent; nothing this run produces is fed into another target

v2_gate_semantics_check.what_v2_actually_does: best_full_program = ranked[0] where ranked sorts the full-batch programs by descending Support aggregate gain; bar_delayed = full_batch_delayed[best_full]; delayed_bar = max(bar_delayed, 0.0). So the bar is the delayed gain of exactly one program -- the highest-Support full-batch one -- floored at identity's zero, and the sign of that program's Support is never checked
v2_gate_semantics_check.what_this_runner_does: bar = max(0.0, max delayed over the evaluated full-batch plans whose Support gain is strictly positive)
v2_gate_semantics_check.difference_and_why: v2 reads one program; this reads the max over the Support-positive ones, which is never lower than identity and never lets a plan nobody could adopt set the bar. The negative-path run copied a wider 'max over all evaluated full-batch delayed' with no eligibility check: on its E3 a plan with Support -0.002312 and delayed +0.084153 set the bar and knocked out a plan that equalled the frozen W4 reference
